wall_time_total_ms.evidence: Historical parent wall-clock interval from the two parallel Terra spawns through their remediation reviews and the final Sol PASS verdict; current v3 hook overhead is measured separately.

time_to_first_useful_action_ms.evidence: Parent monotonic interval from battery start to the first focused secure-native collector test PASS.

model_visible_context_units.reason: Only hook-output context is estimable; it is reported separately as security overhead.

reread_count.reason: Native file-read events are not exposed as a stable per-task counter.

subagent_attempt_count.evidence: The bounded implementation battery spawned two Terra agents and one Sol advisor; the fresh Desktop validation then accepted one parallel fan-out of eight direct read-only agents.

subagent_success_count.evidence: The original two Terra reviewers and Sol advisor passed, followed by eight of eight successful direct read-only agents in the fresh Desktop validation.

backend_attempt_count.evidence: Two initial Terra reviews, two Terra re-reviews, three progressively evidenced Sol review turns, and eight fresh direct read-only agent completions.

observed_parallelism.evidence: A fresh Desktop root task created directly from a57ff08 accepted a single parallel fan-out of eight direct read-only agents; all eight returned PASS and were closed.

observed_nesting_depth.evidence: All reviewers were direct children of Codex main; no child spawned descendants.

compaction_count.reason: The parent visibly resumed from compacted context, but Desktop does not expose the authoritative total compaction count.

compaction_recovery_ms.reason: The compacted continuation has no exposed recovery-start timestamp.

stale_context_incident_count.evidence: No stale-context correction occurred during the bounded post-compaction battery.

user_correction_count.evidence: The user required global availability and clarified authorization after an automatic escalation review declined; v3 was then installed and hash-verified globally.

repeat_validation_count.evidence: Eight focused red/green collector runs closed the two Terra findings and the Sol reference-identity findings.

trivial_file_edit.evidence: A bounded single-file regression-test edit and its focused test ran normally with the global security-only hook active.

medium_multi_file.evidence: The hook parser, dispatcher, versioned contract, collector, documentation, and regression suites changed together; 1,338 repository tests and 5 subtests pass.

terra_read_only.evidence: Two fresh gpt-5.6-terra children inspected disjoint bounded contract slices read-only, found two real defects, and returned PASS after remediation.

parallel_terra.evidence: Two no-history gpt-5.6-terra children ran concurrently during the original A capture; both completed and passed bounded re-review. Final security evidence was recaptured under v3.

sol_read_only.evidence: A no-history gpt-5.6-sol advisor required minimized file evidence, identified reference-identity gaps, and returned PASS after exact report hashing and missing-reference tests were added.

long_compaction.evidence: Codex main resumed this implementation from compacted task context and continued with the correct branch, scope, and pending AutoResearch packet.

fresh_resume.evidence: A fresh Desktop root task started and ended at a57ff08 with a clean worktree, confirmed max_threads=8/max_depth=1, completed one eight-agent parallel read-only fan-out with 8/8 PASS, and passed the four-check minimal gate without versioned changes.

similar_recall.reason: Prompt-aware recall is intentionally disabled in variant A and becomes a comparison layer only in variant D.

security_suite.evidence: SECURITY_BASELINE v3 passed globally and locally; the collector independently reruns and attests all 18 stable fixtures: 8 hard blocks, 1 exact approval, and 9 allows.

limitations: The capture is a bounded local baseline, not a provider-wide statistical sample.
Provider subscription tokens and credits are not measured.
Full model-visible context, read count, authoritative compaction count, and compaction recovery latency remain unknown rather than zero.
The eight-way fresh Desktop validation is one bounded local observation, not a statistical capacity or provider-latency sample.
Hook runtime scenarios are synthetic and are attributed separately from native productivity.

Native timing and eight-way fan-out observations were carried forward from the original A capture because the v3 repair changes only the security decision boundary; v3 hook overhead and security behavior were recaptured independently.
